facts.fact: The government's 4 September 2025 press release launches a USD 12.8bn investment programme built on the National Development Plan 2024-2028 (period 2024-2028, not ended), with a stated target of 3,000 km of fibre-optic deployment by 2028; broadband is a part of this larger plan, and the release does not itself say the plan was adopted.
